title: Atlas Geometry Metadata v1
description: Structural schema for generation-level metadata. Maps to the current /api/models/generate response and GeneratedModel. See docs/bible/07-atlas/139-geometry-metadata-model.md.

generationTimestamp.description: CURRENT: ModelRecord.generated_at (ISO 8601 UTC), set once at generation time, not regenerated on re-read.

boundingBoxes.description: Per-component bounding boxes plus the assembly's aggregate bounding box.

fallbackRecords.description: CURRENT: a subset of GeneratedModel.warnings — specifically those describing a fallback (e.g. the fillet or fuse fallback), not distinguished from other warnings in the current implementation.

inspectionResults.description: PLANNED — no runtime inspection result list is currently attached to generation metadata beyond the single inline fuse-fallback check.
